patch_description: Add a deterministic directed polish that sweeps the ~10 smallest triangles per pass. For each binding vertex, probe moves along the outward-normal directions of the two edges of that small triangle adjacent to the vertex (which increase the triangle's height, hence its area), with step-halving on failure. This targets exactly the binding constraints analytically, complementing the existing random kicks. Integrate it into the final polish stage and after pair exchange.
